summary: Iteration 11 — frontend-only verification of CRASH HARDENING + staged parsing + player navigation stability on the web preview (https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com) at mobile viewport 390x844. RESULTS: (1) STAGED LOADING VERIFIED — Guide painted channels quickly (epg-timeline-grid rendered 36 windowed channel testIDs from a total of 688 in-memory), then EPG stage-2 populated titles in the background (verified via 'Now/Next' text in player header). No red screen, no error-boundary fallback shown. (2) CRITICAL NAVIGATION STABILITY (the primary risk of this iteration) — PASSED. Repeated open→back cycles from the timeline: 4 DIFFERENT channels opened /player and returned to Guide successfully (each time player-back-btn, channel title, and surf-* channel strip all rendered; expected web fallback text 'Unable to play this stream' / 'installed app build' visible; error-boundary-retry NOT visible). Then RAPID 4x open/back on the SAME channel — all 4 succeeded, no crash, no memory blowup. (3) ALL 3 ENTRY POINTS INTO /player VERIFIED — timeline logo (epg-channel-*), box grid card top-tap (box-channel-*), and search result (search-ch-ESPN.us…) all navigate to /player and player-back-btn returns to origin. NOTE: tapping the CENTER of a BoxGrid card still opens the program-detail modal instead (nested Pressables — carryover from iter 10, not a regression). Tapping the top/logo area or the outer testID reliably navigates. (4) ERROR BOUNDARY — App never white-screened during any flow. Root Stack is wrapped in ErrorBoundary (/app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:51-56) and the StreamPlayer inside /player is wrapped in a fallback-null ErrorBoundary (/app/frontend/app/player.tsx:137-144). Confirmed no boundary fallback triggered because no runtime errors were thrown. (5) StreamPlayer.web.tsx is now correctly a placeholder — NO <video> element mounted → the 'empty string passed to src' + 3× 'no supported source' + Mixed-Content console errors reported in iter 10 are GONE this iteration (Real console errors captured = 0 across all flows). Great cleanup. (6) Orientation lock is properly guarded by `canRotate = !web && !Platform.isTV` (/app/frontend/app/player.tsx:44) — on the web preview all ScreenOrientation.lockAsync calls are skipped, so the ERR_SCREEN_ORIENTATION_UNSUPPORTED_ORIENTATION_LOCK crash cannot occur here; TV-side skip is correct by inspection but cannot be exercised on web. (7) TV D-pad focus / hasTVPreferredFocus / focusable={false} on player-surface for TV are code-verified but not testable on web. (8) GROUP CHIPS — chip-All, chip-Favorites, chip-Local, chip-Movies, chip-Sports all present + filter. Channels are alphabetical (verified by first-card '5 Starmax' at position 0). (9) FAVORITES — box-fav-<id> tap persisted; chip-Favorites narrowed FlashList to only the favorited channel; Favorites tab shows Recently Watched with the last opened channel. (10) SEARCH — 'espn' → 5 results (ESPN.us / ESPNHD.us / ESPNEWS.us …); first result search-ch-* → /player OK. IMPORTANT tester tooling note: page.fill() on the RN-Web TextInput does NOT fire onChangeText — must use page.keyboard.type(). (11) SETTINGS — Playlist & EPG card present, settings-refresh-btn present, NO admin/login UI. BUT SEE 'FRONTEND ISSUES' below for a stale-counts bug. (12) NO uncaught JS console errors during any flow. Non-blocking web-only warnings (useNativeDriver, expo-notifications, pointerEvents deprecation) are the same whitelisted ones from prior iterations. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native issues: pointerEvents-prop deprecation still present (carryover, minor).

ui_bugs.issue: Playlist & EPG stats are stale on first mount. On a fresh session after the Guide has painted channels, the Settings tab shows 'Channels loaded 0 / Channels with EPG 0 / Last refreshed —'. Only after tapping settings-refresh-btn does it update to 'Channels loaded 688' (EPG still 0 immediately because the background stage-2 EPG parse hasn't finished at the moment sourceStatus() is re-read). Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:26-32 calls sourceStatus() ONCE in useEffect on mount and never subscribes to subscribeSource(), so the staged-parse emit() events introduced this iteration in /app/frontend/src/source.ts don't refresh the Settings card. Also doRefresh() sets status from the value returned by refreshSource() BEFORE loadEpg() has completed, so the epg count stays 0 in the UI even after EPG eventually finishes parsing. Iter 10 report showed '688 / 665' — this iteration shows '0 / 0' on first open, so it is a regression introduced by the staged-parsing change.

issues: Carryover from iter 10: nested Pressables on the card (nowTitle / next-Pressable) intercept center taps and open the program-detail modal instead of navigating to /player. Only the top-of-card (logo/name) area routes to /player. Not a regression this iteration, just re-noting. Ref: /app/frontend/src/components/BoxGrid.tsx (nested Pressables).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN-Web deprecation warning still logged: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Two occurrences: (a) TimelineGrid now-line indicator — Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:172; (b) player.tsx loading spinner overlay — Reference: /app/frontend/app/player.tsx:150 `<View style={[styles.centerOverlay, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}>` — actually here it's inside style, so this one is fine; only the TimelineGrid occurrence still uses the deprecated prop form.

action_items: MEDIUM: fix stale Settings stats after staged parse. In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx, subscribe to subscribeSource() (from /app/frontend/src/source.ts) inside useEffect and call setStatus(sourceStatus()) inside the callback, so the Playlist & EPG card refreshes when stage-1 M3U and stage-2 EPG parses emit(). Also refresh on screen focus (useFocusEffect from expo-router) as a belt-and-braces so returning to the tab always shows current counts. Currently, on a fresh web session with staged loading, the user sees 'Channels loaded 0' until they manually press Refresh Playlist Now.

OPTIONAL (carryover from iter 10): migrate `pointerEvents="none"` → `style={{pointerEvents:'none'}}` on the now-line View in /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:172 to silence the RN-Web deprecation warning.

OPTIONAL: consider whether tapping the CENTER of a box card should also navigate to /player instead of opening the program-detail modal (nested Pressables intercept). Not a crash concern; UX carryover.

NO functional fixes required for the CRASH-HARDENING scope of this iteration — navigation stability across 3 entry points and 8+ open/back cycles is rock-solid, error-boundary fallback never triggers, and the previous <video>-element noise is gone.
critical_code_review_comments: player.tsx: `hasStream = !!channel?.url` (line 33) gate that only mounts <StreamPlayer/> when a URL exists is correct — combined with the fallback-null ErrorBoundary at lines 137-144 this makes a player-side render error impossible to leak up to the root Stack. Good.

player.tsx orientation guarding: `canRotate = Platform.OS !== 'web' && !Platform.isTV` (line 44) + a 400ms setTimeout before ScreenOrientation.lockAsync (line 52-56) is exactly the right fix for the reported Android-TV `ERR_SCREEN_ORIENTATION_UNSUPPORTED_ORIENTATION_LOCK` crash. TV code path is verified by inspection (cannot be exercised on web).

StreamPlayer.web.tsx now renders NO <video> element — just a black <View/> + calls onStatus('error') so the player screen shows the 'installed app build' fallback. This removes ALL of the empty-src / no-supported-source / Mixed Content warnings that iter 10 flagged. Verified: 0 real console errors in this run.

source.ts staged loading: doFetchParse() correctly does stage-1 (M3U parse → set MEM.channels → persist + emit) then kicks off loadEpg() in the background which sets MEM.programs and emits again. Store's `subscribeSource(() => refresh(true))` re-paints. BUT — the Settings screen does NOT subscribe (see UI bug above) — so it silently misses both emit events. subscribeSource is an internal event bus so it's easy to add a second subscriber.

source.ts EPG trimming to `now-6h..now+2d` (lines 147-148) — good memory reduction for TV boxes. Combined with the 24h cache TTL (line 12) and Platform.OS==='web' skip in persist() (line 186) this shouldn't cause any web-only issues.

ErrorBoundary.tsx is a textbook implementation — componentDidCatch logs, getDerivedStateFromError sets hasError, reset() clears + calls onReset if provided, custom fallback supported (used by player.tsx to render null). hasTVPreferredFocus on the retry button is a nice touch for TV.
app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx TabBarButton with onFocus/onBlur focus ring — correct pattern for D-pad on Android TV. Cannot be visually verified on web but the render path is clean.

TWO IMPORTANT TOOLING NOTES for the next agent: (1) page.fill() on RN-Web TextInput does NOT fire onChangeText — use page.click(input) then page.keyboard.type(text, delay=50). This was the whole reason my first search test spuriously showed 'No results'. (2) FlashList v2 duplicates data-testid on internal buffer containers with a '#<n>' suffix — filter with `if '#' not in tid`. Web-only expected quirks (NOT bugs): storage QuotaExceededError on setItem is swallowed by src/utils/storage.ts; useNativeDriver + expo-notifications + pointerEvents warnings are whitelisted. Crash-hardening scope of iter 11 verified — the only new bug is the Settings stale-stats regression (subscribeSource not wired in settings.tsx).
rca_of_issue: Settings stale stats: Root cause is that /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx captures sourceStatus() only once in a mount-time useEffect. This iteration's new staged-loading pipeline in /app/frontend/src/source.ts publishes updates via subscribeSource() (stage-1 M3U parse emits, stage-2 EPG parse emits again). The store subscribes and re-paints, so the Guide shows channels correctly, but the Settings screen misses both events. First-mount race: if the user opens Settings before stage-1 has populated MEM (very common because the app boots on the Guide tab and the user quickly taps Settings), sourceStatus() returns channel_count=0 and channels_with_epg=0, and the card stays 0 forever until settings-refresh-btn is pressed. Fix: add `useEffect(() => subscribeSource(loadStatus), [loadStatus])` in settings.tsx and/or use useFocusEffect to refresh on tab focus. Reproduction: (a) cold-load https://…/ (b) wait for epg-timeline-grid (c) tap Settings tab → observe 'Channels loaded 0'. (d) Tap Refresh Playlist Now → Channels loaded jumps to 688 (EPG still 0 until stage-2 completes and — because of the same missing subscription — the number never updates automatically even after EPG finishes).
